NATIVE PLATFORM PREVIEWS

Desktop chat. A floating phone assistant.

macOS and Linux previews provide Codex or Gemini chat, selected files, optional system speech and opt-in native shell tasks. They use a standard app window and do not yet include Windows pointer control, session monitoring or microphone dictation.

Android connects to Gemini using your API key. Attach files, hear replies and keep a draggable Karbs face above your other apps. Tap the face to expand its status and Open Karbs / Hide controls.

Phone Assist is off by default. After enabling Karbs in Android Accessibility settings, you can let a task inspect visible screen text, click, type, swipe and open apps. Screen text is sent to your Gemini account during that task. Stop actions from the floating bar. This cannot read private app files, run Codex or bypass protected screens.

Preview setup and limitations

A PRACTICAL WORKSPACE

From a question to a desktop task.

01

Choose your assistant

Use your own Codex sign-in or Gemini API key. Change the provider in chat. A Gemini website or desktop login is separate from the API connection.

02

Work with your files

Attach text and images. Install optional file components to prepare PDF pages and GIF frames for Codex, while keeping the original file intact.

03

Follow desktop actions

Inspect windows, click, type, scroll and run local commands. Reviewed access asks before desktop changes; Full access carries out requested actions with your Windows permissions.

04

Speak when it helps

Optional English voice recognition runs locally. Choose Windows speech or online natural reply playback. You decide whether replies speak aloud.

START WITH A SMALL TASK

Install. Connect.
Make it yours.

Karbs uses your own provider account. It does not include anyone elseâ€™s login or API key.

Read the setup guide

  1. Install the Windows release

    Run the installer when it is available. It sets up desktop components in your user profile and lets you retry an interrupted download.

  2. Connect Codex or Gemini

    Sign in to Codex or save your Gemini API key in Settings. API keys are kept in Windows Credential Manager.

  3. Choose your level of access

    Start with Reviewed access. Full access can change files and apps you can access. It does not bypass Windows permissions.

  4. Add voice and check for updates

    Optional voice setup downloads a speech model. Settings checks for signed releases; installing an update restarts Karbs.

BEFORE YOU INSTALL

A few useful answers.

Is Karbs free?

The source code is MIT licensed. Your chosen AI provider may require an eligible account, usage allowance or paid API access. Karbs does not promise free model usage.

Does Full access control everything?

It allows requested desktop tools without individual Karbs approvals. It uses your current Windows account. OS security, sign-in screens, protected windows and provider restrictions still apply.

Does every code change update my app?

No. Installed apps receive versioned releases. Settings checks for updates and verifies their signatures before installation. A commit alone does not become an update.

Where does my data go?

Settings and temporary working files stay on your device. Your chosen provider receives the prompts, attachments and tool results used for a task. Online speech sends reply text to Microsoft. Read the privacy policy for details.

Can I contribute or report a bug?

Yes. Open a GitHub issue with your app version and steps to reproduce. Remove private content and credentials from any logs.
